content: {"episode_id":"ep-05009","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"I appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 based on the documented clinical indication, acknowledging that prior authorization was missing. The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome. Given the intermittent symptoms and the need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture arrhythmic episodes over an extended monitoring period."}
